findings: An older aggregate project HEAD is not a change to an immutable source event and must not invalidate its checkpoint.
A 100-nanosecond filesystem timestamp reloads at the existing TIMESTAMP(6) database precision; exact Instant equality incorrectly treated the unchanged source as updated.
correction: Exclude aggregate HEAD from content equality, compare instants at existing storage precision, and retain normal invalidation for a real coverage-value or one-second timestamp change.
scope: Synthetic legacy fingerprint and older-head fixture with real H2 flush/clear/reload, plus the existing bounded repaired-window cache regression. No model request; not a production Sol review.
